mapper.select: SELECT FROM delivery_provider_config WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ORDER BY channel
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO delivery_provider_config (workspace_id, channel, provider, endpoint, from_address, from_name, credential_ref, credential_last4, webhook_token_hash, webhook_secret_ref, enabled, idempotent_submission, created_by_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{channel}, #{provider}, #{endpoint}, #{fromAddress}, #{fromName}, #{credentialRef}, #{credentialLast4}, #{webhookTokenHash}, #{webhookSecretRef}, #{enabled}, #{idempotentSubmission}, #{createdById}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE provider = VALUES(provider), endpoint = VALUES(endpoint), from_address = VALUES(from_address), from_name = VALUES(from_name), credential_ref = VALUES(credential_ref), credential_last4 = VALUES(credential_last4), webhook_token_hash = VALUES(webhook_token_hash), webhook_secret_ref = VALUES(webhook_secret_ref), enabled = VALUES(enabled), idempotent_submission = VALUES(idempotent_submission), config_generation = config_generation + 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM delivery_provider_config WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND channel = #{channel}
